summary.text: June Robinson is a Democratic member of the Washington State Senate from District 38, which she has represented since May 13, 2020, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Brad Bender (R).
She previously served in the Washington House of Representatives from 2013 to 2020 and works as a program manager at Public Health Seattle & King County.

paragraphs.text: Robinson earned a B.S. from the University of Delaware and a master's degree in public health from the University of Michigan.
She has been the Program Manager for Public Health Seattle & King County since 2012.
Robinson represented House District 38-Position 1 from 2013 to 2020, when Emily Wicks (D) succeeded her, and succeeded John McCoy (D) in the Senate.
In the 2023-2024 session she was vice chair of the Health & Long Term Care and Ways & Means committees and served on the Labor, Commerce & Tribal Affairs Committee.
